instruction: Install the unpacked browser extension located in the helloExtension folder on the Desktop.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Instruction emphasizes 'browser extension' and 'located in folder'. Evaluator verifies /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension is loaded. Requires navigating to chrome://extensions/, enabling Developer mode, clicking Load unpacked, and selecting the folder.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_find_unpacked_extension_path reads Chrome's Preferences file and extracts all installed extension paths from extensions.settings, which is the correct location for this data
Metric logic is correct: is_in_list checks if the expected path '/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension' is in the list of installed extension paths
Complete coverage: The evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement - that the unpacked extension from the helloExtension folder was installed
Expected value is correct: '/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension' matches the setup config which unzips the extension to that exact location
State accessibility: The getter can successfully access Chrome's Preferences file to read installed extension paths
Runtime feasibility: The evaluation logic will work correctly at runtime - no logical issues detected
